title: Sausage and pepper pasta

items: 12 oz short pasta, such as penne or rigatoni
1 Tbsp kosher salt (for the pasta water)
1 lb Italian sausage, casings removed (or links sliced ½ inch thick)
2 red bell peppers, sliced ¼ inch thick
1 medium yellow onion, sliced ¼ inch thick
Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the 1 Tbsp salt.

Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook 6–8 min, breaking it up (or turning the slices), until browned with no pink left (160°F). Move it to a plate and leave the fat in the pan.
Add the peppers and onion with a pinch of salt. Cook 8–10 min, stirring only every couple of minutes, until soft and charred in spots.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta until al dente. Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Add the garlic to the vegetables and cook 1 min, until fragrant. Return the sausage to the pan.
Add the pasta, parmesan and ½ cup pasta water and toss over medium heat 1–2 min, until glossy. Season with salt and pepper and serve.
tips: Cheesy skillet version: at the end, lower the heat to medium-low, stir in the cream, then the cheddar a handful at a time until melted and creamy. Use less pasta water and sprinkle the parmesan on top.
In a hurry? Swap in 1 jar (12 oz) roasted red peppers, drained and sliced, and add them with the garlic.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days. Reheat in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of water, or in the microwave, until it reaches 165°F. The cheesy version reheats best on the stove with a splash of milk.
